movers.headline: allots **16,85,392 shares at Rs 356, Rs 60.00 crore**, taking **Malabar India Fund from 9.98% to 13.32%**, with **Rs 25.00 crore of promoter warrants alongside**
allots **15,01,434 shares at Rs 348 for cash, Rs 52.25 crore**, to seven non-promoter investors, **Niveshaay Hedgehogs Fund and LC Pharos taking Rs 20.00 crore each**
converts **1,42,78,217 warrants at Rs 23.40, Rs 25.06 crore**, promoter FMV Holdings paying **Rs 17.16 crore** of it
wins a **Rs 476 crore solar-module order from Vikran Engineering** through subsidiary Saatvik Solar Industries for execution by **March 2027**, plus **Rs 132 crore** from an unnamed IPP
approves **Rs 250 crore over two to three years** to expand **Synthetic Iron Oxide Pigment capacity by 50% at Sahupuram**, Phase 1 commissioning **Q4 FY28**, funded by bank debt and accruals

movers.quantum: Rs 116.52 cr for the Apiqo leg; ~15.4% of mcap
movers.headline: acquires **44.94% of Apiqo Organics for Rs 116.52 crore** and **47.41% of Bizotic Lifescience**, both discharged by issuing **8,58,83,617 new shares at Rs 17.85** — no cash leaves the company
approves **~Rs 60 crore for 17,472 spindles and 768 rotors over 15 months** on a fully utilised 32,208-spindle base, citing demand from new free-trade agreements

movers.quantum: Rs 39.15 cr over 5 years; ~105.1% of mcap
movers.headline: wins a **five-year Rs 39.15 crore order from Uttarakhand's Animal Husbandry directorate** to run 35 Mobile Veterinary Units — **Rs 7.12 crore a year** in the filing's own terms

order_wins: **Winsol Engineers** - nine supply, erection and right-of-way orders from **Hinduja Renewables for 33 kV lines in Gujarat, aggregating Rs 15.39 crore excluding GST** _(~11.8% of mcap)_.
**Sharika Enterprises** - a **Rs 10.42 crore work order from the Punjab Energy Development Agency** for 12 W LED solar street-lighting systems across Punjab _(~12.9% of mcap)_.
**Faalcon Concepts** - a **Rs 5.25 crore glass, glazing and facade order** for an office building at Sector 44, Gurugram, from a sole proprietorship _(~14.0% of mcap)_.

**Larsen & Toubro** — subsidiary **LTN Compute wins India's largest single-cluster AI infrastructure order, a 10,000-GPU NVIDIA B300 AI Factory for Together AI**, at Vyoma.AI's Chennai campus; classified *Mega*, **with no rupee value stated**.

**V-Marc India** — three Letters of Intent from **Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam totalling Rs 100.74 crore** (Rs 48.82 cr, Rs 26.26 cr and Rs 25.65 cr), for execution by January 2027 under a price-variation clause _(~1.9% of mcap)_.

**Aurionpro Solutions** — an order **valued close to Rs 100 crore from a global hyperscale data-centre operator** to build and project-manage the digital infrastructure of an AI-ready data centre in Navi Mumbai _(~2.5% of mcap)_.

**Oswal Pumps** — a **Rs 78 crore order including GST** for grid-connected 1.1 kW rooftop solar at **18,089 sites in Darbhanga, Bihar** under PM Surya Ghar, plus ten years of O&M the company sizes at a further Rs 67 crore _(~2.3% of mcap)_.

**Solex Energy** — a **Rs 42.47 crore work order including taxes** from an unnamed domestic power-sector company for N-Type TOPCon 620 Wp glass-to-glass modules, scheduled across October 2026 _(~4.4% of mcap)_.

**Marushika Technology** — an **estimated Rs 30 crore** multi-level car park on a design-build-finance-operate-transfer basis, over a **30-year concession** including one year of construction _(~31.7% of mcap; the value is the filing's own estimate)_.
**CFF Fluid Control** — a **Rs 27.85 crore contract including tax from Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders** for the supply of submarine equipment, for delivery by August 2027 _(~1.3% of mcap)_.

**Below the §5 bar or unpriced:** **NBCC's Rs 234.78 crore** of project-management work orders is 0.94% of mcap, **G R Infraprojects' Rs 91.60 crore** LoA a 45-year concession at 1.1%, and **Time Technoplast's** NTPC hydrogen-locomotive order Rs 2.48 crore.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **GACM Technologies** — **opens a Qualified Institutions Placement of up to Rs 49.50 crore** in Re 1 face-value shares at a premium to the floor price, against an ordinary share line worth **Rs 79.40 crore** and a DVR line worth Rs 9.67 crore.

**Kohinoor Foods** — the board approves a **rights issue of equity not exceeding Rs 105 crore**, against an **Rs 85.75 crore market capitalisation**, with the share count to be fixed after in-principle approval from the exchanges.

**Aplab**, **Rajgor Castor Derivatives**, **Supreme Power Equipment**, **Apar Industries**, **Rollatainers** and **Kshitij Polyline** filed raise-related outcomes with **no fresh issue size stated** in the intimation.
equity_allotments: **Jay Kailash Namkeen** - issues **33,74,375 shares at Rs 45.19, Rs 15.25 crore, to Amar Pramod Talwar for consideration other than cash**, taking 8,000 shares of Vayuveer Solutions in exchange _(~57.5% of mcap)_.

**Mercury EV-Tech — capital that was never raised.** Its **Rs 85.07 crore** is the upfront 25% on warrants whose holders **failed to pay the balance within 18 months**; the warrants **stood forfeited** and the money moved to capital reserve _(typed `warrant_conversion_past`)_.

**Exhicon Events Media Solutions** — a preferential allotment committee clears **Rs 16.25 crore** of securities _(~2.4% of mcap)_, while **Kanpur Plastipack** converted warrants worth Rs 0.84 crore and **Retaggio Industries** allotted to its promoter group.

**Euro India Fresh Foods** (4,64,410 securities), **Yaap Digital** (4,43,103 shares) and **UVS Hospitality** filed preferential allotments with **no rupee value in the intimation**, so nothing is published for them.
m_and_a: **Gretex Industries** - approves acquiring **Chaitak Sales and its subsidiary Dailmer Industries**, which become wholly-owned and step-down subsidiaries; the outcome states no consideration.

**TTK Prestige / EFC (I) — one deal, filed from both sides.** TTK sells its **51% of Ultrafresh Modular Solutions for Rs 27.54 crore in an EFC share swap**, completing by 31-Oct; **EFC books the cost of acquiring 100% at Rs 54 crore** _(~2.1% of EFC's mcap)_.

**Foseco India / Vesuvius India — also both sides.** Foseco buys Vesuvius's **Mehsana crucibles, stoppers and sleeves facility as a going concern by slump sale for Rs 43.25 crore**, a unit that turned over Rs 58.13 crore, or 2.76% of Vesuvius's revenue.

**Waaree Energies** — subsidiary Waaree Power signs a **joint venture with SmartenGrand to manufacture power-application diodes and set up a semiconductor fabrication unit in Gujarat**, holding 86.83% to SmartenGrand's 13.17%; **no consideration is stated**.

**Zuari Industries** — buys up to **Rs 150 crore of Texmaco Infrastructure & Holdings shares from Zuari International, its own wholly-owned subsidiary**, so the consideration does not leave the group _(cf. L&T/Vyoma, 11-Aug)_.

**JSW Cement** — will sell down **up to Rs 123.00 crore of JSW One Platforms shares as a promoter selling shareholder in that company's IPO**, a figure its own resolution spells out in words as *One Hundred and Three Crores* _(~0.7% of mcap)_.

**CapitalNumbers Infotech** — **pays USD 24,51,288.49, or Rs 23.40 crore**, completing the purchase of Epitome Cloud Inc; the **Rs 40 crore** the store carries is the headline of the **03-Jul** share purchase agreement, not today's payment.

**Adani Enterprises** — a wholly-owned subsidiary **completes a cash acquisition of 100% of an entity's capital contribution for Rs 91.34 crore**, subject to closing adjustments, which is 0.02% of market capitalisation and so is not surfaced.

**B-Right Realestate** — a subsidiary signs an MoU to redevelop a Borivali SRA project yielding about 5 lakh sq ft, at an **expected gross development value of Rs 1,600 crore** _(172% of mcap; a GDV is expected sales value, not a contract award)_.

**Retro Green Revolution** — signs a **non-binding MOU to invest up to Rs 45 crore for up to 60% of Gyscoal Enterprise**, subject to due diligence and definitive agreements, against its own **Rs 4.90 crore market value** _(scraped after the first freeze)_.

**L. T. Elevator** — the board **discontinues the proposed Ricardo Elevators merger** agreed under a January term sheet, and separately approves a preferential issue of **up to Rs 12.99 crore** _(~2.8% of mcap; scraped after the first freeze)_.

**Sudarshan Pharma** (76% of a target, part cash and 40 lakh promoter shares), **Indigo Paints**, **DCX Systems**, **BHEL**, **Nephrocare Health**, **Teamlease** and **Aurobindo Pharma** filed deals or tie-ups with **no consideration stated**.
capex_core: **Kothari Industrial Corporation** - signs MoUs with **Guidance, Government of Tamil Nadu** for a **~Rs 1,000 crore non-leather footwear plant** at Ramanathapuram and a **~Rs 50 crore design university** at Hosur _(64.2% of mcap; envisaged investment under an MoU, not a committed spend)_.
**Maiden Forgings** - sells a **vacant Ghaziabad land parcel for Rs 12.90 crore**, the proceeds earmarked for its new Murad Nagar unit _(~8.3% of mcap)_.

**Fujiyama Power Systems** — is **setting up a 1,200 MW solar cell facility at Ratlam for around Rs 350 crore**, having commissioned 2,000 MW each of module and power-electronics capacity there, with 2,000 MW of lithium-ion to follow in Q2 FY27 _(~2.9% of mcap)_.

**Trishakti Industries** — signs a **Rs 125 crore MoU with XCMG for a 900-tonne heavy-lift crane** for its wind-energy rental fleet _(~33.6% of mcap; this is equipment the company is buying, not an order it has won)_.

**Max Healthcare** — approves **about Rs 425 crore for Tower 3 at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Vaishali**, on a one-acre parcel adjoining the existing hospital, which is 0.4% of a Rs 98,054 crore market capitalisation.

**Mahamaya Steel — §6 skips captive power.** Its **Rs 70 crore purchase of ~350 acres in Janjgir-Champa** is explicitly for a **solar plant for captive consumption** in its steel operations, a power-cost item rather than core capacity _(cf. Sambhv Steel, 12-Aug)_.

**IIRM Holdings** — converts a **Rs 34.78 crore intercompany loan into 29,98,385 equity shares of its own wholly-owned subsidiary** IIRM Global at Rs 116, so no external capital moves _(cf. Viyash/Alivira, 11-Aug)_.

**Nexxus Petro Industries** — commissions a **30 TPD used-tyre pyrolysis oil facility**, scalable to 60 TPD; the **Rs 400 crore** in the same release is the chairman's **projected FY turnover**, and the plant's own target is Rs 25-30 crore of revenue.

**Madhav Marbles & Granites** — the **Rs 50 crore, Rs 10 crore and Rs 55 crore** on this row are **related-party transaction ceilings being revised** for three group entities pending the AGM, not capital expenditure of any kind.
business_updates: **Results season, and it is the great majority of the day** — **703 companies filed results, transcripts or presentations**, including **Max Healthcare** (Q1 revenue Rs 2,982 cr), **JSW Cement** (Rs 1,896 cr), **Honasa** (Rs 785 cr) and **Brigade Enterprises** (Rs 1,179 cr).

**Lords Mark Industries — guidance, not a transaction.** The company **expects FY2027 consolidated revenue of at least Rs 1,550 crore and PAT of at least Rs 178 crore**, and plans two 70-bed oncology pilots at Vapi and Solapur on a **proposed Rs 200 crore debt raise**.

**Aditya Birla Real Estate** — Birla Estates enters Navi Mumbai with the **redevelopment of Shiv Sai Co-operative Housing Society in Vashi across 3.06 acres**, which it sizes at **Rs 2,600 crore of revenue potential** _(~16.9% of mcap; a potential, not a booking)_.

**Paisalo Digital** — signs a **Rs 500 crore co-lending MoU with FatakPay** on an 80:20 funding split for micro-enterprise and MSME credit; the figure is an **overall facility limit** on an NBFC's ordinary business, not capital raised.

**Genus Power Infrastructures — an order book is not an order.** Its board noted a **Rs 24,020 crore total executable order book at 30-Jun**, of which **Rs 22,183 crore flows through the Gemstar Infra JV** in which Genus holds 26% _(cf. SEPC and Wabag, 12-Aug)_.

**Jindal Stainless's Rs 42,955 crore** is **FY26 consolidated revenue** in an Integrated Annual Report press note, and **Max Financial's Rs 14,977 crore** is consolidated revenue including investment income — both results figures on `press_release` rows.

**Escorts Kubota** (product launch), **TVS Motor** (a Sri Lanka EV initiative), **Thomas Cook**, **Wanbury** (a Rivaroxaban API approval) and **Kapston Services** filed updates with **no commercial terms**.
distress_risk: **Reliance Communications — the day's largest 'capex' figure is an audit qualification.** The auditors record **Rs 39,078 crore of interest not provided on borrowings** to the previous year end, plus Rs 1,134 crore for the quarter, on a company in CIRP.

**Nitin Castings** files a Post Offer Public Announcement; **Quadrant Televentures** held its twelfth committee-of-creditors meeting; **Supreme Engineering** reports a **one-time settlement with Bank of India**, the day's one clearly favourable outcome.

**Kridhan Infra** received a **SEBI show-cause notice**, and **KEC International**, **Imagicaaworld**, **Taurian MPS**, **DCM** and **JBF Industries** filed litigation or distress disclosures that **quantify no impact**.
other_notable: **Cohance Lifesciences** - CRISIL **migrates the rated lower-limit facilities from AA-/Positive to BB/Stable on an issuer-not-cooperating basis and then withdraws them**; the company says its India Ratings coverage is unaffected.

**SIS** — commences an **open-market buyback of up to Rs 106.00 crore at no more than Rs 478.50 a share**, undertaking to deploy at least 75%, or Rs 79.50 crore, before it may close early _(~1.7% of mcap)_.

**Already published — Advanced Enzyme Technologies.** Today's **Rs 69.70 crore** filing is the compliance certificate for the same open-market buyback carried on **08-Aug** and flagged as a duplicate again on **11-Aug**; this is its third pass.

**Already published — Shalimar Paints.** Its **Rs 6,895.22 crore** CCPS leg, the Rs 3,544.69 crore equity leg and the Rs 1,000 crore QIP for the **Hella Infra Market swap** all ran as a mover in yesterday's digest; today merely re-files the same board outcome.

**Central Depository Services — the target's capital is not the price.** Its **Rs 1,084 crore** is **ONDC's total paid-up capital**; CDSL is subscribing **Rs 5.00 crore** of fresh equity and its holding **falls from 1.85% to 1.67%** on dilution.

**Credit-rating actions are theme-only and never movers (§3), and these are facility sizes rather than notch changes:** **Aditya Birla Real Estate Rs 32,248 crore** (a Crisil AA reaffirmation, removed from watch), **Cohance Rs 547.96 crore** and **Alicon Castalloy Rs 300 crore**.
**Shareholding and SAST disclosures (names only, §1):** 30 rows carried without detail, and **Azad India Mobility** filed a share sub-division, which §6 never surfaces as a mover.

tally: 2026-08-13: 3,253 announcements captured (00:06–23:57 IST) on a Thursday results tape — **703 companies filed results, transcripts or presentations** — with 1,355 material rows -> **8 verified movers**. The day's defining feature is capital going into small companies at prices that matter to them: **three separate preferential allotments carrying a named superstar**, led by **Malabar India Fund taking Virtuoso Optoelectronics from 9.98% to 13.32% in a Rs 60.00 crore equity leg**, **Niveshaay Hedgehogs Fund and LC Pharos each putting Rs 20.00 crore into Bhagyanagar India's Rs 52.25 crore issue**, and **Vikasa India EIF I Fund converting Rs 5.27 crore of Fischer Medical warrants**. The largest genuine transaction is **Saatvik Green Energy's Rs 476 crore solar-module order from Vikran Engineering**, and the most consequential relative to size are two capacity additions the baseline could not see: **DCW's Rs 250 crore expansion of Synthetic Iron Oxide Pigment capacity by 50%** and **Sri Ramakrishna Mills' Rs 60 crore spindle addition at 150.6% of its own market value**. **Anlon Healthcare** buys control stakes in two chemical businesses entirely in paper, and **Raminfo** wins a five-year veterinary-unit contract worth more than the company. Ten baseline movers failed: **the four largest stored figures are all results or audit numbers** — including **Reliance Communications' Rs 39,078 crore of interest an auditor says was NOT provided** — **CDSL's Rs 1,084 crore is ONDC's paid-up capital against a Rs 5.00 crore cheque**, **Shalimar Paints and Advanced Enzymes are cross-day duplicates**, and **Mercury EV-Tech's Rs 85.07 crore is warrant money forfeited, not capital raised**.
